answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the jetty beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is logged in the lantern index and the trellis audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 126 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
